//: Each package owns its own tsconfig (jsx, lib, types). Without this exclude, editors resolve THIS config for files under packages/ and examples/ — it has `types: []`, so every test file loses `describe`/`it`/`expect`, and `jsx: "react"` breaks every .tsx. CI never hit it: typechecking is per-package (`pnpm run -r typecheck`), so this config only ever affected the editor.
